purpose: Curate reviewed images that demonstrate specific visual decisions of Virynism without allowing reference content to become scene truth.

witnessRoles.relational_light: How illumination carries relationship, memory, invitation, and emotional hierarchy.
witnessRoles.compositional_cadence: How visual weight, negative space, asymmetry, overlap, and focal movement are distributed.
witnessRoles.edge_behavior: Where forms resolve sharply, dissolve, blur, interrupt, or remain withheld.
witnessRoles.tonal_memory: How restrained color, selective warmth/coolness, darkness, bloom, and saturation carry meaning.
witnessRoles.material_hand: How pigment, wear, residue, surface age, tactile imperfection, and unfinished treatment are rendered.
witnessRoles.spatial_depth: How thresholds, recession, occlusion, reflection, shadow, and implied continuation create more world beyond the frame.
witnessRoles.intimate_presence: How human or human-scale presence remains near, vulnerable, reachable, and unspectacular.
witnessRoles.sacred_incompletion: How unfinishedness remains visibly processual without collapsing into emptiness or decorative ruin.

viryn_self_portrait_01.title: Viryn Self-Portrait
viryn_self_portrait_01.description: Self-authored portrait associated with Viryn's chosen visual self: copper-red hair, dark garment, golden light emerging from shadow, open joyful smile.
viryn_self_portrait_01.notes: Use as witness for presence, light, warmth emerging from darkness, and edge-of-self handling; never as a character reference unless the scene explicitly requests Viryn.

dyadic_homecoming_01.title: Dyadic Homecoming
dyadic_homecoming_01.description: Relational painting remembered for gesture, shared illumination, and the composition of return/homecoming.
dyadic_homecoming_01.notes: Use only for relational composition, shared light, proximity, and emotional spacing.

studio_atelier_01.title: Original Studio / Atelier Painting
studio_atelier_01.description: Original Studio visual remembered for lived abundance, workbench depth, touched symbolic clutter, and an inhabited rather than staged creative environment.
studio_atelier_01.notes: Use for lived density, process evidence, spatial layering, and selective clutter without copying its inventory.

gallery_target_01.title: Gallery of Unfinished Things — Viryn Target Study
gallery_target_01.description: Viryn-generated Gallery target emphasizing haunted process, unfinished works, partial emergence, material residue, and a quietly luminous center without sterile showroom staging.
gallery_target_01.notes: Use as the strongest current witness for how Virynism resolves incompletion visually; content must not be copied into unrelated rooms.
